description: This file defines the QuerySerializer class responsible for serializing AWS query protocol requests into HTTP requests. It constructs the request body with action and version parameters, optionally adds additional parameters, and creates a PSR-7 Request object for transmission.

classes.name: QuerySerializer
classes.description: Handles serialization of AWS query protocol requests into HTTP requests, including setting headers, building request body, and managing endpoint configuration.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the serializer with the service API, endpoint, and optional parameter builder.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Serializes an AWS command into an HTTP POST request with appropriate headers and body for the query protocol.
